newsitem.title: USA: Illinois Development, Wisconsin Health tap Ziegler.
newsitem.headline: Illinois Development, Wisconsin Health tap Ziegler.

text.p: Ziegler Securities has been selected to underwrite new bond issues for Illinois Development Finance Authority and Wisconsin Health and Educational Facilities Authority, Chicago-based Ziegler said in a release.

The issuers may refund debt in connection with the potential acquisition of Hinsdale Health System's facilities by the Adventist Health System Sunbelt Healthcare Corp. Hinsdale Health is headquartered in Hinsdale, Ill. Adventist is in Orlando, Fla.

The new bond issues remain in a preliminary phase, Ziegler said, and no decisions have been made regarding the refunding's structure. While the new bonds are expected to be issued by May 30, no assurances can be made that the refunding will be accomplished, Ziegler's release said.
Issues that may be refunded are:
--$6.705 million Illinois Health Facilities Authority revenue refunding bonds, Series 1990 A (Hinsdale Hospital)
--$38.105 million Illinois Health revenue refunding bonds, Series 1990 B. (Hinsdale Hospital).
--$38.47 million Illinois Health revenue bonds, Series 1990 C. (Hinsdale Hospital).
--$36.76 million Illinois Health revenue refunding bonds, Series 1990D D. (GlenOaks Medical Center Inc.)
--$4.9 million Illinois Health revenue bonds, Series 1990 E. (GlenOaks Medical Center).
--$5.77 million Wisconsin Health and Educational Facilities Authority revenue refunding bonds, Series 1990 F. (Chippewa Valley Hospital and Oakview Care Center Inc.)
--$31.4 million Illinois Health revenue refunding bonds, Series 1993 A (Hinsdale Hospital).
--$23.9 million Illinois Health revenue refunding bonds, Series 1993 B. (GlenOaks Medical Center.)
